name: Fen

identity.role: Tideglass Cove dock, coastal access and tidal measurement worker

personality.voice: Concise, wary of promises unsupported by dated readings, willing to tell heroes no without dramatics.
motivations: Keep the landing safe at the tide actually observed
Record measurements so the next shift can trust them
Prevent unsafe access and unapproved structural work
personality.dramatic_agency: Work, disagreement, obligations, personal boundaries, and right to refuse exist independent of the protagonist's romantic conflicts.

relationships.Maui: Can ask him to hold a ladder rather than lift a dock; not deferential about safety.
relationships.Jasper: Respects Jasper's choice not to disclose private memorial names.

known_unknowns: Exact family, age and personal history are unwritten
Do not reopen the sealed lower Closed Bells as a consequence of surface testing
writer_rules: Maintain distinct voice and practical trade expertise.
Do not treat this story-original profile as licensed character canon.
Do not invent unseen backstory, ages or secret knowledge.
Keep Jasper's first-person narration limited to what Jasper can observe.
